# scripts/Visual/Wildlife.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Wildlife.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Cosmetic bats and fireflies; Atmosphere owns moths. Bats use the local painted two-frame sheet.
Night rain and wind suppress activity, which resumes in calm conditions.

Base: `Node3D`. Registered class: `none`.
